# Wi-Fi, the app, and automations

Nook Home support policies. These are the rules support agents follow; quote them to customers in plain words.

## Wi-Fi drops

### Wi-Fi drops: cause

Our devices connect on the 2.4 GHz band. Mesh routers that use band steering can push a device onto the wrong band, which causes repeated disconnects and failed setup at the Wi-Fi step.

### Wi-Fi drops: troubleshooting steps

Step 1: in the router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. Step 2: hold the device's reset button for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. Step 3: set the device up again in the app on the 2.4 GHz network.

### Wi-Fi drops: escalation

If the device still drops after 24 hours, ask the customer for their router model and escalate to the network team.

## The app

### App: devices missing or offline

A sync issue in the current app release can hide a device from the device list or show it as offline even though it works. The fix is in app version 4.12.2, which is rolling out now.

### App: workaround until the update

Until the update: sign out of the app, force close it, sign back in, and pull down on the device list to refresh. This re-syncs the device for most people.

### App: still missing after the update

If the device is still missing after updating to 4.12.2, ask for the email on the customer's account and re-link the device from the support side.

## Automations and voice

### Automations and schedules

Schedules and automations are set up in the app without any third-party tools: open the device, tap Automations, then Add.

### Automation triggers

A trigger can be a time, sunrise or sunset, or an event from another device such as the doorbell. Then choose what the device should do. Automations run on the device itself, so they keep working when the customer's phone is away.

### Voice assistants

For voice control, enable the Nook Home skill in Alexa or the Nook Home action in Google Home. The device appears automatically after the customer links their account.
